propositions: Auto-deploy kills review-bot container mid-review, leaving in-flight review incomplete and casting fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks automatic recovery.

Drain timeout (45s) is too short for actual review duration (up to 911s); raising DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1200 and stop_grace_period to 1320s allows in-flight reviews to complete before container shutdown.
Coverage-gap decisions with retryable reasons (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should post no vote instead of -1, leaving changes eligible for backfill reconciler re-drive.
Record attempts per (change_id, revision) in review_attempts table; after RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3), escalate by casting fail-closed -1 and emitting VOTER_ERROR.
Indeterminate and finding outcomes remain terminal (vote -1); only retryable gaps and teardown-mid-review defer voting and emit REVIEW_RETRY_DEFERRED marker.
